zh.title: A-10攻擊機自50年飛行員培訓基地執行最後一次飛行架次
zh.summary: A-10攻擊機已自培訓飛行員50年的基地完成最後一次飛行架次。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，A-10 攻擊機（A-10 Warthog）已從過去 50 年來負責培訓其飛行員的基地，正式執行最後一次飛行架次。該項飛行任務代表該型攻擊機在該專屬訓練基地長達半個世紀的飛行培訓任務正式告一段落。
相關消息指出，該座基地在過去 50 年間扮演培訓 A-10 攻擊機飛行員的核心角色。隨著該型機逐漸退出相關訓練編制，該處封存場地（boneyard）也正式向最後一批 A-10 攻擊機告別，代表該基地的相關飛行訓練歷史告終。

en.title: A-10 Warthog Flies Final Sortie From 50-Year Pilot Training Base
en.summary: The A-10 Warthog completed its final sortie from its 50-year pilot training base.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, the A-10 Warthog attack aircraft has flown its final sortie from the air base that trained its pilots for 50 years. The flight marks the end of half a century of pilot training operations for the aircraft type at the facility.

The report indicates that the location, which served as a primary pilot training hub for 50 years, is concluding its operational era with the aircraft type. As the remaining aircraft transition, the boneyard facility is bidding farewell to its final Warthogs, marking the conclusion of training missions at the base.
